hook_line: MUMBAI HOSTS EARTHSHOT PRIZE, TWO INDIAN FINALISTS CHASE £1 MILLION

hook_stat.sub: Prize for each of the five Earthshot winners in Mumbai

news_summary: Mumbai hosts The Earthshot Prize Awards Night on November 17, the prize's first edition in India, where 15 finalists compete across five categories and five winners receive £1 million each.
payoff: The five winners are announced on the night and each receives £1 million to scale their solution.

stats.label: Finalists chosen from nearly 7,000 nominations across 169 countries
Electric last-mile vehicles sold by finalist Mahindra Last Mile Mobility
Cool roofs installed by finalist Mahila Housing Trust
